name: mesh_params
description: Compute the diffuse-interface parameter eps, the element counts and the derived phase-field parameters for the lunar_regolith_DSM solver from the simulation parameters. Units are in the argument names (m, degrees C, m/s). Give exactly one of alpha_c (condensation coefficient) or sigma_surf. Returns eps_m, mesh (h, nx, ny, nz), resolution (elements across the 5-95 % and 1-99 % bands), eps bounds with the binding one, derived tau_sub/lam_sub/M_sub, and a list of checks with status ok/note/warn/fail. Never hand-tune eps: use this tool. Does not write files.

front_velocity_m_per_s.description: Normal front velocity v_n [m/s] for KP Eq. 45

feature_radius_m.description: If given, v_n = d0/(beta_sub*feature_radius_m) overrides the velocity

thermal_channel.description: Heat-channel diffusivity: mean = D*_ia (solver), ice = k_i/C_i

xi_v.description: Time-scaling factor; enables the KP Eq. 48 check
